title: Morbific
summary: MORBIF'IC MORBIF'ICAL, adjective [Latin morbus, disease, and facio, to make. Causing disease; generating a sickly state; as morbific matter.

inlines.v: MORBIF'IC MORBIF'ICAL, adjective [Latin morbus, disease, and facio, to make. Causing disease; generating a sickly state; as morbific matter.
